Owner smoke intake 2026-10-26. Proposed priority P3. Sources F11. Acceptance/evidence: docs/planning/roadmap-reviews/2026-10-26-smoke-triage.md. Stub; investigation/specification required. Release hold unchanged.

Owner design ruling 2026-10-30 (via Blurby.Brain1): detect duplicates by content hash; duplicate marker plus a choose-which-to-keep action; the chosen-away copy is removed from the library only, unless the owner confirms a dialog naming the full path, in which case its file goes to the Recycle Bin (shell.trashItem, never unlink). Main validates the path through the IPC-PATH-TRUST rules (doc id only from the renderer; never bundled or cache paths) and re-hashes both copies before trashing. Still a Stub.
